tvShow.name: One Pace
tvShow.overview:
Monkey D. Luffy sets off on an adventure with his pirate crew in hopes of finding the greatest treasure ever, known as the "One Piece."

One Pace is a fan project that recuts the One Piece anime in an endeavor to bring it more in line with the pacing of the original manga by Eiichiro Oda. The team accomplishes this by removing filler scenes not present in the source material, fixing animation errors and correcting subtitles.

episodes.name: One Piece Fan Letter
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch Straw Hat Stories 📺 Ep One Piece Fan Letter

As the Straw Hat Pirates reunite on the Sabaody Archipelago, the various members of the island are drawn together like pieces of a puzzle, their love of certain members of the crew driving their actions and emotions.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Occasionally, the One Pace team likes to have some extra fun, so we made animated specials. See alternative storylines with twists you might not have expected.

episodes.name: Romance Dawn, the Dawn of an Adventure
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1📺 Ep 312

Influenced by the straw-hat-wearing pirate Red-Haired Shanks, an enthusiastic young boy named Monkey D. Luffy dreams of one day becoming King of the Pirates.

episodes.name: They Call Him "Straw Hat" Luffy
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 2📺 Ep 1

While Alvida and her pirates plunder a cruise ship, they come across a barrel containing a strange boy named Monkey D. Luffy. The timid Koby befriends Luffy, and they share their grand dreams with each other.

episodes.name: The Pirate King and the Master Swordsman
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 3-4📺 Ep 2, 19

In search of members for his pirate crew, Luffy with his new friend Koby arrive at Shells Town. There, they track down the renowned Pirate Hunter Zoro but run afoul of Helmeppo, son of the infamous Captain Morgan.

episodes.name: The First
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 5-7📺 Ep 3

Luffy convinces the captive Zoro to join his pirate crew, but they must first defeat the tyrannical Captain Morgan.

seasons.name: Romance Dawn
seasons.overview: Monkey D. Luffy sets out on an adventure to form a crew, find the legendary One Piece, and become the Pirate King.

episodes.name: Enter: Nami
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 8-11📺 Ep 4-6

Nami, a street-smart girl who loves money and tangerines, makes Luffy's acquaintance. To save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, she tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to the infamous pirate Buggy the Clown.

episodes.name: Treasure
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 12-19📺 Ep 6-7

Luffy meets a small dog guarding his late master’s store. Meanwhile, Beast Tamer Mohji, Cabaji the Acrobat, and the lion Richie show up in the streets of Orange Town to get revenge for Captain Buggy's humiliating loss.

episodes.name: Pirate Buggy "the Clown"
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 19-21📺 Ep 8

Shockingly, it turns out Captain Buggy and Red-Haired Shanks share a common history. When the bombastic clown rips Shanks' straw hat, Luffy's rage knows no bounds.

seasons.name: Orange Town
seasons.overview: Luffy and Zoro run afoul of a flashy crew of pirates and their captain, Buggy the Clown. They are joined by a young girl named Nami who helps them navigate this predicament.

episodes.name: Captain Usopp
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 23-25📺 Ep 9-10

With Nami joining as Luffy's navigator (though not as an actual member of the crew), they arrive at Syrup Village in search of a proper ship. There they meet a man claiming to be a pirate captain who also seems to have ties to Red-Haired Shanks.

episodes.name: Captain Kuro
episodes.overview: After uncovering a devious plot, Usopp warns the village and Kaya, but finds his years of lying make it difficult to convince people of the truth.

episodes.name: The Slope
episodes.overview: Usopp resolves that if he is to keep the peace, the town must continue to believe he is a liar, which means he cannot let Captain Kuro’s men up the slope to the village! Luffy, Zoro, and Nami aid Usopp in his plan to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

episodes.name: The Silent Man
episodes.overview: Captain Kuro makes his appearance, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy incapacitated, and Usopp and Nami too weak to make a stand, the situation is desperate. However, Kaya herself arrives, intent on bargaining with Kuro.

episodes.name: The Pirate "Kuro of a Hundred Plans"
episodes.overview: While the fight between Luffy and Kuro continues, Jango works to force Kaya to bequeath her family's money to the Black Cat captain. Despite the Usopp Pirates' efforts to stop the hypnotist, it seems as if the transaction is all but inevitable.

episodes.name: For Whom the Bell Tolls
episodes.overview: Kuro's ultimate move attacks everything in the area, friend nor foe notwithstanding, and Luffy becomes enraged by Kuro's lack of regard for his crew.

episodes.name: To the Sea
episodes.overview: The island is saved without any villagers ever knowing what almost befell their home. Kaya, grateful to the Straw Hats for what they did, gifts them something invaluable for sailing the high seas. Meanwhile, one more person joins Luffy's crew.

seasons.name: Syrup Village
seasons.overview: Luffy's fledgling pirate crew arrives at the slopes of Syrup Village. There they find a liar and a conspiracy to steal a young lady's fortune.

seasons.name: Gaimon
seasons.overview: With Usopp now on the crew and their new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure. There they encounter a strange man stuck in a box who has been looking for the same treasure.

seasons.name: Baratie
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats head to the ocean-going restaurant, Baratie, with the hopes of recruiting one of their cooks. In the meantime, hungry yet powerful forces gather to lay siege to the restaurant — all while a menacing swordsman from the Grand Line steadily approaches.

seasons.name: Arlong Park
seasons.overview: Nami's hometown has long been overrun by Arlong and his band of fishmen from the Grand Line. When the Straw Hats arrive, they find that their prospective navigator has left out a few key details about herself.

seasons.name: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
seasons.overview: Buggy, after being defeated by Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, begins his quest to regain his body parts and his crew, and then he will get his flashy revenge on Luffy.

episodes.name: The Town of Beginnings and Endings

seasons.name: Loguetown
seasons.overview: The final island before entering the Grand Line: Loguetown. Luffy and his crew drop anchor to stock up, sightsee, and pay their respects to the place where Gold Roger drew his last breath.

seasons.name: Reverse Mountain
seasons.overview: Reverse Mountain is the entrance to the Grand Line. What await the Straw Hats are impossible water currents, a giant whale, and dubious people going by codenames.

seasons.name: Whisky Peak
seasons.overview: The first island on the Grand Line is surprisingly welcoming to pirates. But as night falls, a deadly plot unravels.

seasons.name: The Trials of Koby-Meppo
seasons.overview: Koby and Helmeppo are new cabin boys for the marines, but they become unwillingly involved in an escape attempt by Morgan. Their bravery will either earn them the respect of their superiors—as well as Vice Admiral Garp—or it will spell their doom.

seasons.name: Little Garden
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats vow to bring Princess Vivi to Alabasta, and their journey brings them to Little Garden, an island from prehistoria that is home to creatures and people larger than life.

seasons.name: Drum Island
seasons.overview: When Nami falls ill, the crew makes a detour from Alabasta to seek medical help. They happen upon a winter island inhabited by a distrusting populace and a single doctor with a mysterious reindeer companion.

episodes.name: Adventure in the Kingdom of Sand

seasons.name: Alabasta
seasons.overview: Alabasta teeters on the edge of civil war, and it's up to Princess Vivi and the Straw Hats to stem the rebellion, uncover the plot of Baroque Works, and beat the Warlord Crocodile.

episodes.name: Why the Log Pose Is Spherical
The Highest Authority in the World

seasons.name: Jaya
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats seek the fabled sky island Skypiea and head to Jaya for information on its whereabouts. Their convictions are tested by the pirates of Mock Town, but not everyone on the island is a hardline skeptic.

episodes.name: The Village Hidden in the Clouds
On the Front Line of Love's Salvation

seasons.name: Skypiea
seasons.overview: Arriving at Skypiea, the Straw Hats are instantly met with unfamiliar sights, objects, and customs. What's more, the god of the sky island deems the Blue Sea dwellers to be trespassing and casts his judgment upon them.

seasons.name: Long Ring Long Land
seasons.overview: On Long Ring Long Land, the Straw Hats are challenged to a Davy Back Fight. As they dive headfirst into a series of games with serious outcomes, the best the Navy has to offer has meanwhile begun to pay closer attention to certain Straw Hat crewmembers.

episodes.name: The City of Water, Water Seven
episodes.overview: The keepers of Shift Station, Kokoro and her granddaughter Chimney, point the Straw Hats in the direction of the metropolitan Water Seven. The nearby city is regarded as the best place to find a decent shipwright for the Going Merry.

episodes.name: Mr. Iceburg
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats cash in their Skypiean gold and meet up with Iceburg, the celebrity mayor of Water Seven, to see about an appraisal for their ship's repairs. While the foreman Kaku checks the Merry, dubious people eye the pirates' money.

episodes.name: The Case of the Kidnapped Pirate
episodes.overview: Kalifa shows Luffy and co. around Dock One and tells them about Iceburg and Galley-La Company. During the tour, Kaku returns with some bad news, and a long-nosed Straw Hat goes missing… along with the money he was watching!

episodes.name: Impasse
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats raid the Franky House, but they soon find that their real target, Franky, is long gone with the stolen money. When the battered Usopp awakens, nothing can prepare him to hear what Luffy has decided about the Merry.

episodes.name: Luffy vs. Usopp
episodes.overview: Usopp is unwilling to say farewell to the Going Merry… not without a fight, that is! He challenges his former captain to a duel between men, so Luffy honors the pride of his former crewmate and faces him in battle.

episodes.name: Warning
episodes.overview: Iceburg has been shot! When Luffy and Nami decide to go check on him, the fire-breathing, half-mechanical Franky challenges the Straw Hats’ captain. Before their fight gets too heated, Galley-La swoops in with an unexpected accusation!

episodes.name: Rumors
episodes.overview: Things are hectic enough with Franky going after Luffy, but now the Straw Hats are being framed for a crime seemingly committed by Nico Robin. As if to put the proverbial icing on the cake, the annual storm Aqua Laguna is on its way toward Water Seven.

episodes.name: Devil
episodes.overview: Nico Robin appears to be working alongside a World Government shadow organization called CP9. When the Straw Hats learn about Robin's current affiliation, Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin and make her talk.

episodes.name: Cipher Pol No. 9
episodes.overview: Robin and her tall, mysterious, masked companion arrive at Iceburg's room, and she learns that he possesses blueprints to the ancient weapon Pluton, spoken of in the poneglyphs. Then, shockingly, the members of CP9 unmask themselves.

episodes.name: Six Powers
episodes.overview: Luffy's group finally catches up to Robin, but they are greeted by disappointment—Robin opts to stay with CP9 and leave the Straw Hats. As Robin turns away from Luffy, the members of CP9 confronts the pirates.

episodes.name: Klabautermann
episodes.overview: As Usopp works to repair the Going Merry, he contends with Franky's insistence on dismantling it. During this time, Usopp reflects on who it was that conducted the ship's repairs while in Skypiea, and Franky confirms his suspicions.

episodes.name: The Legendary Shipwright
episodes.overview: In the past, Franky—a.k.a. Cutty Flam—was part of the legendary Tom's Workers, and he and Iceburg helped create the sea train. Spandam, a member of CP5, was determined to get Tom's blueprints for Pluton by any means necessary.

episodes.name: Mr. Tom
episodes.overview: The old fishman Tom was framed by CP5 for the crime of attacking the Marines with Franky's battleships. As the World Government hauled Tom off to Enies Lobby, Franky received a lasting reminder to take pride in the ships he builds.

episodes.name: Bingo
episodes.overview: CP9 hauls away Franky and Usopp, but not before giving a coldhearted farewell to the Merry. At Galley-La’s HQ, Nami learns from Iceburg the truth behind Robin's betrayal and the difficult choice she had to make to save the lives of the Straw Hats.

episodes.name: Departing Shortly
episodes.overview: While the members of Galley-La help Chopper search for Luffy and Zoro, Nami rushes to the departing sea train to keep Robin from sacrificing her freedom. At the station, a man finds Nami and hands her a letter from Sanji.

episodes.name: Aqua Laguna
episodes.overview: Sanji coolly fights his way through the sea train and locates Usopp and Franky. Back in Water Seven, Kokoro sees how determined Luffy is to save Robin, so she and Iceburg lend the Straw Hat crew an unexpected helping hand.

episodes.name: Sogeking
episodes.overview: Rocketman blasts out of Water Seven and connects with the sea tracks, and old foes become allies for the coming struggle. Aqua Laguna swells, and it's up to Luffy and Zoro to combine their might and create safe passage for all aboard.

episodes.name: Ramen Kenpo
episodes.overview: Sogeking appears in grand fashion! Wanze threatens Sanji's group with his ramen kenpo, so the Straw Hat cook urges the others ahead. Franky takes on CP9's newest recruit “Sea Weasel” Nero, and Sogeking moves forward to meet up with Robin.

episodes.name: The Honorable Captain T-Bone
episodes.overview: In his battle against Wanze and his strange Ramen Kenpo, Sanji makes an exception to his rule of never using his hands. Meanwhile, Franky and Nero are baffled by each other’s abilities, and back on Rocketman, Zoro clashes with “Ship-Slasher” T-Bone.

episodes.name: Necessary Evil
episodes.overview: Sanji and Franky conclude their fights and enter the train car where CP9’s agents lie in wait. When Sogeking sees the danger of the situation, it falls to him to formulate a plan for escape. However, CP9 is far from being thwarted!

seasons.name: Water Seven
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats make landfall at the glorious city of Water Seven, known worldwide for its unparalleled shipyards. The pirates go to inquire about repairs for their ship, but the city threatens to take their money, their ship, and their crewmates.

episodes.name: The Big Showdown on the Judiciary Island!!
Express to the Main Island of Enies Lobby
The Girl They Called a Devil

seasons.name: Enies Lobby
seasons.overview: In order to free Nico Robin from the clutches of the World Government, the Straw Hats and their allies must invade the judicial island, Enies Lobby, and take on the government's premiere clandestine unit: CP9.

episodes.name: The Strongest Family Lineage?! The Vice-Admiral and The Revolutionary!
The Extent of the Grand Line and The 600,000,000 Crew!
The Astonishing Thousand Sunny and Usopp's Tearful Apology!
The Circling Bounties and The Duel on Banaro Island!

seasons.name: Post-Enies Lobby
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats return to Water Seven after the ordeal at Enies Lobby. While there, they are met by a familial vice admiral, and they await news of their new ship.

Adventure on the Ghost Island and the Famous Doctor Hogback!
The Invisible Man and the Secret of the Mansion!
General Zombie Night! Thriller Bark's Mysterious Four

Zoro vs. Ryuuma and Chopper's Rage!
Show Yourselves, Straw Hat Pirates! The Crew's Hopeless Counterattack!
Clash! The Titanic Battle Against Zombie 900!
The Mysterious Visitor! The Two Warlords Meet!
Combination of Brains and Brawn! Oars and Moriah vs. the Straw Hats!
The Crew's Annihilation! Oars vs. Nightmare Luffy
Morning Comes! The Straw Hats' Ultimate Attack!
The Power That Can Deflect Anything?! Zoro Fights Prepared to Die!
Brook's Past! The Rumbar Pirates and Laboon!

seasons.name: Thriller Bark
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats' next destination is Fishman Island, but first they must traverse the dreaded Florian Triangle which is known for many eerie and mysterious things such as disappearing crews, conversational skeletons, and a floating island full of zombies and other horrors.

episodes.name: Adventure on the Archipelago of Dancing Soap Bubbles

seasons.name: Sabaody Archipelago
seasons.overview: The second half of the Grand Line lays just ahead, so the Straw Hats stop at Sabaody Archipelago to plan the way forward. But being so close to the Holy Land and Navy Headquarters, Luffy's crew comes face-to-face with the darkest forces of the World Government.

episodes.name: Adventure on the Island of Women
No One Can Stop This Now

seasons.name: Amazon Lily
seasons.overview: Luffy is separated from his crew, and he finds himself on an unfamiliar island in the middle of the Calm Belt... an island inhabited only by women where men are prohibited from entering.

seasons.name: Impel Down
seasons.overview: Luffy launches a daring rescue mission to break his big brother Ace from the government prison, Impel Down. It's a race to the prison's lowest levels — a literal journey through hell itself.

seasons.name: The Adventures of the Straw Hats
seasons.overview: Somewhere in the world... Sanji resists, while Robin meets terrible people. Franky's not himself, and Usopp learns to survive. Chopper avoids becoming food, and Nami reports on the weather. Brook is repaid in underpants, and Zoro... is lost and annoyed.

episodes.name: The Man Who Shook the World
A Gift to a New Era

seasons.name: Marineford
seasons.overview: Pirate Whitebeard and his allies on one side; the Navy and its Seven Warlords on the other. At the center of it all: Portgas D. Ace and his unspeakable past and heritage. Luffy races to Ace's execution scaffold as a battle between the world's most powerful people unfolds.

seasons.name: Post-War
seasons.overview: The war has taken its toll on the world, and Luffy reminisces about younger days when he first met Ace and became his brother. To become strong enough to withstand the New World, Luffy must make a critical decision for himself and his crew.

seasons.name: Return to Sabaody
seasons.overview: Two years have passed since the Straw Hats were forcibly separated, and they reconvene back at Sabaody stronger and even more committed to the journey ahead.

episodes.name: Into the Depths! The Kraken and the Caribou Pirates
Adventure in the Ocean Depths! 10 Kilometers Below the Surface!
Landing on Fishman Island! The Mermaid Cove and Gyoverly Hills!
Arrival at Coral Hill! The Nosebleed and the Devastating Prediction!
The King of Fishman Island Invited to Ryugu Palace!
The Mermaid Princess in Hard-Shell Tower! Shirahoshi of the Neptune Family!
The Shirahoshi Kidnapping Incident and the Curse of the Mato Mato!
The Beginning of the Vengeful Plan! Zoro vs. Hody!
At the Sea Forest! Arlong and Hody
Otohime, Fisher Tiger, and the Sun Pirates! The Fateful Encounter!
The Shocking Truth of Tiger! The End of the Sun Pirates
The Shipwrecked Celestial Dragon! A Bullet That Seals the Future
Shaking of the Kingdom! Luffy vs. Jinbe!
Gyoncorde Plaza Gathering! The Evil Drug's True Power
Hody's Dark Secret! The Straw Hats' Arrival
100,000 vs. 10! The Straw Hats' Explosive Moves
The General from the Future Land and the Crisis of Fishman Island's Destruction
The Voice from the New World

seasons.name: Fishman Island
seasons.overview: The path the to the New World takes the Straw Hats thousands of leagues under the sea to the underwater Fishman Island. However, the island's dark past is reaching a breaking point, and Luffy and his crew are caught in the middle of the conflict.

episodes.name: Blizzard with a Chance of Slime
Vergo and Joker! The Beginning of Caesar's Masterplan!
G-5's Sacrifice and the Betrayal of the Vice Admiral!
The Mastermind in the Shadows and the Battle Between Gas and Rubber!
Vice Admiral vs. Vice Admiral and the Truth Behind Punk Hazard's Destruction!
The Dragon Named Momonosuke and the Menacing Snow Fruit User!
Zoro's Strongest One-Sword Style and Mocha's Plight!
Luffy and Law's All-out Attack! The Takeover of the New Era!
The Strongest Grizzly Magnum and the Assassins from Dressrosa!
Die for Me! The Dangerous Man Makes His Move!
The Alliance's Target and the Departure!
The Arrival of the Mysterious Man and the News Coo!

seasons.name: Punk Hazard
seasons.overview: The first island of the New World is a strange place covered in flames on one half, and freezing temperatures on the other. What seems at first to be an unlivable place later reveals a laboratory, a maniac scientist, and a certain Warlord of the Sea.

episodes.name: Arriving at Dressrosa! The Country of Passion, Love, and Toys!
The Colosseum of Many New Faces and Maynard the Pursuer!
Bellamy's Changed Motivations and B Block's Start!
B Block on Fire! Outlandish Competitors and King Punch!
To Green Bit! The Adventure in the Land of Dwarves!
Closely Contested Block C! Lucy and Ucy!
C Block's Blazing Battle and the Forgotten of Dressrosa!
The Tontatta Rebellion and the C Block Finale!
A Sad Past! Rebecca and Soldier-san
D Block's Fiery Start and the Heavenly Demon's Revelation!
Law's New Strategy and the Colosseum's Underground Nightmare!
The Plight of the Riku Clan! The Lurking Hero Awaits in the Shadows!
The Spear of Elbaph and Don Sai

seasons.name: Dressrosa
seasons.overview: Luffy's alliance with Law brings him next to Dressrosa to take down Doflamingo's booming business. But the crazed warlord and self-proclaimed ruler of Dressrosa has control over everyone and everything.

episodes.name: Momonosuke, Heir of the Kozuki Family

seasons.name: Zou
seasons.overview: Zou cannot be reached by conventional means, nor is it easy to enter once one finds it. Within its secretive walls lie the Mink Tribe, and the Straw Hats soon discover that the people of Zou hold a piece of the puzzle that unlocks the mysteries of the world.

episodes.name: Mink Pedro, Captain of the Guardians

seasons.name: Whole Cake Island
seasons.overview: Luffy will not sail the seas without his cook, so he stubbornly goes after Sanji to Whole Cake Island. However, knocking on an emperor's door is easier said than done.

seasons.name: Reverie
seasons.overview: Every four years, the leaders of the world gather at the Holy Land to discuss a mutually agreed upon path for the government. During this particular Reverie, many parties with their own agendas arrive... and some are uninvited.

episodes.name: Shimotsuki Yasuie, the Daimyo of Hakumai
The Day of the Mountain God
The Sake I Brewed to Drink With You
The Battle of Monsters on Onigashima
Leader of the Mt. Atama Thieves, Ashura Doji

seasons.name: Wano
seasons.overview: The Straw Hats finally regroup in Wano to carry out theirs and their allies' ultimate goal: to see to the Emperor Kaido's downfall and restore the Kozuki family to its rightful place of power.

episodes.name: New Emperors
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1058-1059📺 Ep 1086-1088

The Straw Hats rave over new bounties, and Crocodile and Mihawk pay Buggy a visit. Elsewhere, Dragon and his revolutionaries are shocked when they read about Sabo in the news, and an old comrade returns, a shell of his former self.

episodes.name: The Matter Involving Captain Koby
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1059-1060📺 Ep 1087-1088

The three-way struggle between the Marines, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

episodes.name: Future Island Egghead
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1060-1061📺 Ep 1089-1090

Sabo contacts his comrades, which prompts a certain eavesdropper to take action against an entire island nation! Meanwhile, Luffy, Chopper, and Jinbe alongside a mysterious girl become separated from the rest of the Straw Hats when a giant shark attacks.

episodes.name: Adventure in the Land of Science
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1062-1063📺 Ep 1091-1093

Franky and Luffy's groups are split up, but each encounter a person claiming to be Dr. Vegapunk. On the island, Luffy and co. find convenient food and futuristic clothing, but when a pacifista shows up, Bonney reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes.name: The Six Vegapunks
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1064-1065📺 Ep 1093-1095

Lilith takes the Sunny and its remaining crew to the laboratory in the clouds, where a new threat lurking within its corridors attacks unexpectedly. As the battle ensues, Vegapunk's satellites look on with excitement.

episodes.name: The Will of Ohara
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1066📺 Ep 1096-1097

Vegapunk Shaka shares his theory about an ancient kingdom and the Void Century. He also reminisces about the foundation of Dragon's Revolutionary Army. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot when something surprising happens.

episodes.name: Punk Records
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1067-1068📺 Ep 1097-1099

After Vegapunk shares his dream with Luffy's group, he asks the Straw Hat captain for a big favor. Meanwhile, CP0 ignores their lack of invitation to Egghead and get around the island defenses to make landfall.

episodes.name: The Strongest Form of Humanity
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1069-1070📺 Ep 1099-1102

As the rematch between Luffy and Lucci kicks off, Dr. Vegapunk notices something very fascinating about the Straw Hat captain's new abilities. Meanwhile, Sentomaru arrives with the latest pacifista models as a very unlikely ally to the pirates!

episodes.name: The Weight of Memory
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1071-1072📺 Ep 1102-1104

To avenge her father, Bonney chases Dr. Vegapunk through the lab, but a familiar symbol catches her eye. As she investigates, the satellites call in an unexpected favor to finally deal with CP0's rampage outside the lab.

episodes.name: Miss Buckingham Stussy
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1073-1074📺 Ep 1104-1107

Upon mysterious orders, Stussy betrays Lucci and Kaku. Lilith and Edison also hurry outside the lab to stop the rampaging seraphim. Meanwhile, the main Dr. Vegapunk goes missing, and Admiral Kizaru escorts a powerful and commanding entity toward Egghead.

episodes.name: Labophase Death Game
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1075-1076📺 Ep 1107-1109

The search for Dr. Vegapunk's main body is threatened by the deadly seraphim, only this time the satellites' orders are unable to pacify them. Faced with a tough decision, Luffy and Zoro must team up with the most unlikely of allies.

episodes.name: Escape Limit
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1077-1078📺 Ep 1108, 1110-1111

Luffy, Zoro, Lucci, and Kaku combine their might, and a chivalrous cook rescues Nami from near defeat. Meanwhile, Lilith, Usopp, and Franky are stopped in their tracks by someone very deadly, yet very cute.

episodes.name: The Emperor's Crew, The Red Hair Pirates
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1079📺 Ep 1112

Eustass "Captain" Kid sails in, guns blazing against Elbaph while Shanks of the Red Hair Pirates defends his crew and friends... without an ounce of mercy.

episodes.name: The Legendary Hero
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1080-1081📺 Ep 1113-1115

While Koby desperately attempts to flee Beehive, Cross Guild's bounty entices the hundreds of pirates there to hunt him down. But before they can seal his fate and claim the prize, a familiar Marine warship descends from the sky!

episodes.name: Let's Go and Take It!!
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1082-1083📺 Ep 1116-1117

While Cross Guild grows into a serious concern for the Marines, Buggy makes an impassioned speech to spur his crew into a zealous fervor. Additionally, Sabo returns to his comrades and begins his report on the events that happened at the Reverie.

episodes.name: The Attempted Murder of a Celestial Dragon
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1084-1085📺 Ep 1118-1119

During the Reverie, Sabo and Bonney met and worked together toward the same goal. King Cobra also met with the Five Elders to ask some hard questions, in the process learning the dark truth of the world.

episodes.name: The Five Elders
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1085-1086📺 Ep 1119-1120

At the time of the Reverie, Wapol overheard something he shouldn't have and fled the Holy Land with an unlikely partner. On the heels of these events, Imu ordered the Five Elders to test a devastating weapon engineered by Dr. Vegapunk!

episodes.name: The Final Lesson
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1087-1088📺 Ep 1121-1122

At Pirate Island, Vice Admiral Garp continues the Koby extraction mission, but Avalo Pizarro's devil fruit powers threaten to sink the rescue ship. Garp, weakened from an attack by Shiryu, entrusts the operation's success to the next generation.

episodes.name: Hostage Situation
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1089-1090📺 Ep 1123-1124

In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Marines, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.

episodes.name: Sentomaru
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1091-1092📺 Ep 1125-1126

Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall, but Sentomaru stands in his way while the Straw Hats attempt to move the Sunny to the back side of the island. And back at Mary Geoise, Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in the way of the ever-advancing Kuma.

episodes.name: Luffy vs. Kizaru
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch 1093-1094📺 Ep 1127-1128

Luffy faces off in a spectacular aerial battle against Admiral Kizaru, but this time, Straw Hat is 100 times stronger than before. Unbeknownst to those on Egghead, something ominous is about to make an appearance on the island...

episodes.name: Kuma Bear
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch N/A📺 Ep N/A

Born with the rare blood of the Buccaneer people, young Kuma was fated to lead a life of persecution at the hands of the Celestial Dragons, but his father instilled hope within him through the legend of Nika and the Drums of Liberation.

episodes.name: Ginny
episodes.overview:
📖 Ch N/A📺 Ep N/A

Kuma lived with Ginny in his old village until the injustices of the world pushed them to join Iva and Dragon as revolutionaries. However, when tragedy befell Ginny, Kuma found a new purpose in life in the newborn she left behind.

seasons.name: Egghead
seasons.overview: Futuristic tech, giant alien monsters, battle robots, superhuman clones... Who are all these people calling themselves Dr. Vegapunk, and why is the government after one of their own?
